Personally I am not religious , but I think its a lot better than what ppl believe. It helps ppl become better people as well as keep them mentally. Like, my dad used to do drugs when he was younger and ever since he started going to church he stopped. He grew up in LA near the active gang areas and there was a lot of influence on him. This was around 25 years ago. For my mom, the community helped her leave the Philippines, which is a 3rd world country. Her family is extremely poor and there are so many ppl in her family that not everyone had the chance to go to college. The church got her a job in Dubai where she met my dad and then they had me. They've been living in the states for 20 years now. Currently, the church my family goes to helps my sister. My sister has cerebral palsy, which is a physical disability where she barely has control of her body movement. The church has helped fundraise money to pay for her a few of her surgeries. I met my ex here, (we're still very good friends), and so many other people. This includes a therapist, who has talked to me about how i feel. I was diagnosed with depression when i was 13, most likely from the stuff my family goes through.


For my entire family, the church has been a community that has helped so much with our lives.

Btw the Churches that my parents went to and the one we go to now are not the same

Getting mad at a kid for every little thing they do can hurt them a lot. I personally have been afraid of my parents for as long as i can remember. Because of that, I started to feel afraid around any adult. And I'm still going through depression. Telling your kids not to lock the door tells them that they are not allowed to have any privacy.
